idea-plugin.name: Claude Code Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
Launches Claude Code for the current project in a separate terminal window, from a button in the Project view toolbar.

The button opens a dropdown with:

  • Run Claude Code runs claude in the project root.
  • Run with Options... lets you edit the command line, such as claude -c or claude --resume. The command is saved per project.
  • Create .claude creates a .claude folder in the project root.

Requirements

  • The claude CLI installed and available on PATH.
  • Windows: opens a maximized cmd.exe window.
  • macOS: opens Terminal.app. macOS asks once whether the IDE may control Terminal; allow it.
  • Linux: uses the first terminal found among gnome-terminal, konsole, xfce4-terminal, x-terminal-emulator, tilix, kitty, alacritty and xterm.

Tested on Windows. macOS and Linux are supported but not yet tested; please report problems on GitHub.

This is an unofficial plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

Source code and issues: GitHub
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.6

  • Cyrillic text in the command, such as a prompt, is no longer altered. Look-alike Cyrillic letters typed on a Russian layout are fixed only outside quotes and only in words that become fully Latin, so claude -с still becomes claude -c.

1.0.5

  • macOS: quotes in the command and project path are handled correctly; launch errors, such as a denied Automation permission, are shown in a dialog.
  • Linux: supports gnome-terminal, konsole, xfce4-terminal, tilix, kitty, alacritty and xterm in addition to x-terminal-emulator; the command runs in your interactive shell so PATH from ~/.bashrc or ~/.zshrc applies.
